title: Gano ainihin matsalar, farashi ta daidai, lashe abokin ciniki na gaba

say: Gano ainihin matsalar, farashin ta daidai, kuma lashe abokin ciniki na gaba.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na uku na Abubuwan Tuntuba.
Taron ganowa ba na siyarwa bane. Tambayoyi masu kyau suna nuna ƙwarewar ku fiye da kowace ƙasida.

say: Yawancin ƙwararrun masu ba da shawara sun rasa kuɗi akan farashi, saboda suna ƙidaya sa'o'i kawai.

say: Karanta game da abokin ciniki da farko, rubuta hasashe guda uku, kuma aika gajeriyar ajanda. Tabbatar cewa mai yanke shawara ya shiga, aƙalla na tsawon mintuna 10 na ƙarshe.

Tambayi game da tasiri, yunƙurin baya da kasafin kuɗi
Maimaita abin da kuka ji

say: Tambayi abin da matsalar ke kashe kowane wata, abin da suka rigaya gwada, da kuma wanene dole ne ya yarda kafin a fara aiki.

say: Koyaushe sanya lamba akan matsalar kafin farashin aikinku.
Almajirai 420 akan naira 350,000 a kowane zangon karatu shine naira 147,000,000.
18% har yanzu ba a biya ba a ƙarshen wa'adin. Naira miliyan 26,460,000 kenan.
Makarantar da ke da kyau da take sha'awar tana adana kuɗaɗen da ba ta biya kusan kashi 5%, wanda zai zama 7,350,000.
Tazarar dai ita ce Naira miliyan 19,110,000 a kowane wa’adi, sai kuma malamai biyu da suka yi murabus saboda rashin albashi. Yanzu duka bangarorin biyu sun san abin da matsalar ke da daraja.
Ngozi na bukatar naira miliyan 24,000,000 a shekara, gami da kudin kasuwanci. Tana tsammanin kusan kwanaki 120 ne kawai, bayan siyarwa, admin da hutu. Don haka adadin ranarta ya kai naira 200,000.

panel.heading: Gina kuɗin daga bangarorin biyu
items: Adadin rana = buƙatar samun kudin shiga tare da farashi ÷ kwanakin da za a iya biya
Kudi = kwanakin shirin aiki × ƙimar rana, da haɗari
Duba shi akan darajar sakamakon
Yarda da matakan biyan kuɗi a rubuce

say: Shirin aikinta na makarantar shine kwanaki 18, naira miliyan 3,600,000. Tare da 10% don haɗari, ta zagaya zuwa 4,000,000.

say: Wannan shine kusan kashi 21% na ingantaccen wa'adi ɗaya, kuma amfanin yana maimaita kowane wa'adi. Don haka ba ta rangwame.

say: Zaɓin A shine ganewar asali kawai, akan naira 2,500,000.

panel.heading: Bayar da zaɓi na iyaka, ba rangwame ba

cards.d: Yana ƙara sabon tsarin biyan kuɗi, rubutun tunatarwa da hanyoyin biyan kuɗi da aka saita tare da ma'aikata. Naira 4,000,000.
Yana ƙara watanni biyu na rajistan shiga da taron horar da ma'aikata. Naira 5,500,000.

say: Zaɓin B yana ƙara aikin ƙira, a 4,000,000. Yawancin abokan ciniki suna zaɓar zaɓi na tsakiya.

say: Harafinku suna suna iyawa kuma, kamar yadda yake da mahimmanci, abin da aka cire. Ya jera abubuwan da za a iya bayarwa, abin da abokin ciniki dole ne ya samar, kudade da matakai, yadda ake farashin ƙarin aiki, da yadda ake adana bayanan abokin ciniki da sharewa.
Don manyan kwangilolin gwamnati ko na gwamnati, tambayi lauya ya sake duba sharuɗɗan.

panel.heading: Abin da wasiƙar dole ta kunsa
items: Iyakar: abin da aka haɗa da kuma cire
Abubuwan da ake bayarwa tare da kwanakin ƙarshe
Ayyukan abokin ciniki
Kudade, matakai, jinkirin biya
Canja buƙatun da sirri

say: Ngozi ta rubuta nazarin shari'a mai shafi ɗaya: mahallin, ƙalubale, tsari, sakamako da aka auna, da darussa. Maigidan ya yarda a rubuce cewa makarantar za a iya kwatantawa amma ba a ambaci sunanta ba.

panel.heading: Mai gaskiya kafin da bayan
left: 18% na kudaden da ba a biya ba
right: 7% na kudaden da ba a biya ba

say: Kudaden da ba a biya ba sun ragu zuwa kashi 7 cikin 100, wanda hakan ya nuna an samu karin kusan naira miliyan 16,170,000. Ta kuma ce kashi 5% har yanzu ba a kai ga cimma ba. Wannan gaskiyar ta sa ta zama abin gaskatawa.
Bayyana duk wani rikici na sha'awa, da kuma kiyaye bayanan abokin ciniki a asirce bayan aikin ya ƙare.

say: Riƙe aikin bincike na mintuna 45 kuma ku kashe matsalar tare da alkaluman mai shi. Yi lissafin adadin kwanakinku, rubuta zaɓuɓɓuka uku kuma rubuta harafin. Sannan rubuta binciken shari'ar ku da shirin ku na kwanaki 90.
Yanzu ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
